title: AI startups are eating the venture industry and the returns, so far, are good | TechCrunch
summary: AI startups raised a record-high share of venture capital last year, with significant funding rounds for companies like xAI, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The venture market shows a trend of larger funding rounds and high internal rates of return (IRR) for newer funds backing AI startups.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights the strong performance and high valuations of AI startups receiving substantial funding, indicating a positive market sentiment towards these companies.
